page.layout: One printed page, very faded. Upper block of about 18 lines of running text across the full width. Middle block of about 4 short lines, centred. Lower block of about 12 lines of text across the full width. No running head, page number, catchword or signature is legible. No margin notes can be distinguished.
page.notes: The scan is almost entirely faded. The text blocks show only as blurred smudges, and I cannot read any word with confidence, so I have not transcribed any letters. The line counts and letter counts are estimates from the shapes of the blocks. The paragraph divisions are guesses. No heading, page number, running head or signature can be made out. A few small dark specks are visible in the lower half; these are dust, not print.
